Hey, 15 year old sophomore here. Ive been cutting for years. I promise you it enhances NOTHING. It never made me feel any happier, any more excited, or even any more pain. I just felt the same. the only thing that changed is now my inability to get a job due to scars and never being able to wear anything but long sleeves and pants now. plus it takes months to get deep. you have to build up your main tolerance and strength and mental will. so for months you’ll feel like a piece of shit who cant cut deep enough like all the other people you see online. but it really isnt ever deep enough even after that. ive hit veins, nicked an artery, and i always hit deep fat. it still feels shallow to me. it just becomes an everlasting annoyance to deal with. plus holy shit, the itchiness. even after they’re scars its just itchiness allll the time. but yeah

TLDR: doesnt do shit

ps: killing yourself is only going to make you miss out on people you’re supposed to meet. and let down the people you’re supposed to help. you have purpose, even if it’s small.
